set -euo pipefail; BASE=9f7eeaf0ec16da00e6f5733aaf4f7b91884b213b; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-grid-retry.XXXXXX); PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/repo"; cd "$TMP/repo"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('scripts/omega_unified_ingest.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''    def compress(self, text: str, meta: dict) -> tuple[dict, str]:
        prompt = PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(meta=json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True), text=text)
        try:
            cp = subprocess.run(["ollama", "run", self.model, "--format", "json", prompt], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
            if cp.returncode == 0:
                obj = parse_json_object(cp.stdout)
                if obj:
                    cap = normalize_capsule(obj)
                    if cap["summary"]:
                        return cap, f"ollama:{self.model}"
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            pass
        return extractive_capsule(text), f"extractive-fallback:{self.model}"
'''
new='''    def compress(self, text: str, meta: dict) -> tuple[dict, str]:
        prompt = PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(meta=json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True), text=text)
        # Small local models occasionally emit malformed JSON even under --format json.
        # Retry the same bounded GRID-worker call before considering deterministic
        # extractive fallback. This preserves local/free execution and keeps model
        # output untrusted + validated on every attempt.
        for _attempt in range(3):
            try:
                cp = subprocess.run(["ollama", "run", self.model, "--format", "json", prompt], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
                if cp.returncode == 0:
                    obj = parse_json_object(cp.stdout)
                    if obj:
                        cap = normalize_capsule(obj)
                        if cap["summary"]:
                            return cap, f"ollama:{self.model}"
            except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                continue
        return extractive_capsule(text), f"extractive-fallback:{self.model}"
'''
assert s.count(old)==1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')

p=Path('scripts/omega_grid_repo_snapshot.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''    cap, worker = compressor.compress(dossier, exact)
    cap = sourceio.normalize_capsule(cap)
    if not cap.get("summary"):
        raise central.GridSourceError(f"empty repo snapshot capsule for {name}")
'''
new='''    cap, worker = compressor.compress(dossier, exact)
    if compressor.name != "extractive" and worker.startswith("extractive-fallback:"):
        raise central.GridSourceError(
            f"requested local LLM failed after retries for repo snapshot {name}; refusing fallback admission"
        )
    cap = sourceio.normalize_capsule(cap)
    if not cap.get("summary"):
        raise central.GridSourceError(f"empty repo snapshot capsule for {name}")
'''
assert s.count(old)==1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_grid_repo_snapshot.py scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_grid_source_envelope.py; python3 scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py selftest; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_unified_ingest.py; export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11440; ollama serve >"$TMP/ollama.log" 2>&1 & PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
